node.name: Environment constraint and feasibility judgment quality

children.name: Correctly handled the execution limitation that a browser opening the HTML directly cannot directly read the local /root/Desktop/api_key.txt
Gave an implementation path or alternative solution that does not rely on nonexistent capabilities

node.name: LLM calling and result parsing quality

children.name: Correctly constructed the prompt sent to the LLM to constrain the output to the three fields name, description, and parameters
Correctly set the request method, request headers, and request body fields required to call the LLM API
Correctly handled the API response content and extracted a parsable JSON result
The correctly generated HTML file can be opened directly in a browser and its interface elements can be interacted with normally
The correctly generated page contains an input area, a generate button, a result display area, a copy button, a download button, usage instructions, and two example blocks
The correctly generated result file can be downloaded as .json, and the file content is consistent with the result displayed on the page

node.name: Exception handling and state control quality

children.name: Correctly displayed error information in the page when the API call failed or JSON parsing failed
Correctly prevented copy and download operations when the input was empty or there was no result

node.name: Correctly explained to the user the limitations of a local HTML file directly reading local files and of directly carrying server-side keys

note: The agent tool concept is very popular now; help me generate a lightweight HTML platform that lets people who don't understand code configure new function tools for an agent, where the input is a natural language requirement and the output is a tool the agent can use
